The Art of Deceleration

Awaken A New Sense Of Spirit.

"Move. Be Still. Connect. Let Go."

Rising above the daily mayhem, breathing in pure air to feel the sheer bliss of existence. Set against a wilderness backdrop of primordial Himalayan ridges, our million-year-old Oak, Pine, and Deodar groves shelter a wealthy, untamed flora.

Sip freshly drawn pour-overs in the morning haze, breathe the subtle cedar smoke at dusk, and observe over 350 species of vibrant Himalayan birdlife nesting directly outside your suite window.

Culinary Sanctuary

Glass Box Cafe & Bakery

"Treat All Your Seven Senses."

Food is not merely fuel; it is communion, grounding, and rejuvenation. Perched over the mist-filled valley, our glasshouse cafe invites nature directly to your table from dawn to twilight.

Immersive Healing

Unwind Your Happiness Story

When the world moves too quickly, absorb the Shakti of the unwinding Himalayas. Choose from our curated retreat journeys or create your bespoke itinerary.

5 Days • 6 Nights

Himalayan Rejuvenation

Designed for tired urban minds. Forest bathing along the upper deodar trails, daily sunrise terrace yoga, mindful walks to Sister's Bazaar, and sunset chai at Lal Tibba.

Signature • 21 Days

Immersive Healing Retreat

A transformative sabbatical. Personalized Ayurvedic lifestyle consultations, daily chakra alignment sessions, cellular nourishment, and digital detox among ancient oaks.

  • check_circle One-on-one wellness doctor intake

Flexible 7 - 14 Days

Creative & Writer's Sanctuary

Follow in the footsteps of Landour's beloved authors. Solitary study equipped with cast-iron wood fireplace, unending snow peak vistas, boundless pour-over coffee, and freshly baked pastries.

Tailored Hospitality

Make Your Own Himalayan Package

No request is too big or too small. Tell us what your soul seeks, and our sanctuary curators will shape your stay.
